newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-OLAZABAL NAMED GOLFER OF THE MONTH AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL NAMED GOLFER OF THE MONTH AGAIN.

text.p: Jose Maria Olazabal of Spain has been voted European Tour Golfer of the Month for the second successive time for his victory in the Turespana Masters on March 23.
The 31-year-old Spaniard, who is on a comeback after missing nearly 18 months of action with chronic foot problems, captured his title in only his third tournament following the lengthy break.

Olazabal, who is playing in this week's U.S. Masters at Augusta where he won three years ago, began his comeback at the Dubai Desert Classic in February where he finished joint 12th. That earned him his first award.
Two weeks later he was fourth at the Portuguese Open before capping his return at the Turespana Masters on Gran Canaria.
He tied for seventh in the Freeport-McDermott Classic in New Orleans on Sunday and is 51 under par for his 16 rounds since returning to competition.
Olazabal, once the world number two, has advanced more than 100 places in the world rankings since his return. He had dropped to 229th position before the Desert Classic, but has climbed to 119th.
On Tuesday it was announced he will take part in the English Open from May 15-18 at a new venue, Hanbury Manor, northeast of London, his first tournament in Britain since the 1995 British Open.

He will also play in the European zone final of the Andersen Consulting world championship on the Monday and Tuesday following the English Open, as well as the British PGA Championship at Wentworth from May 23-26.
